송이.forms: Native numbers + 송이: 한 송이, 두 송이, 장미 열 송이
송이.m: counter for flowers; bunch (of grapes), cluster
송이.ex: 생일에 친구에게 장미 열 송이를 선물했어요.
송이.x: I gave my friend ten roses for her birthday.
송이.e: Also counts grapes and bananas in bunches: 포도 한 송이.
송이.t: Word order is noun + number + counter: 꽃 세 송이 = three flowers.

흥미.ex: 저는 어렸을 때부터 역사에 흥미가 많았어요.
흥미.x: I've been very interested in history since I was young.
흥미.t: 흥미 is interest or fun in a subject; 관심 is attention or concern, also toward people.

뽑다.m: to pull out; to pick, to choose, to elect; to hire
뽑다.x: My classmates chose me as class president.
뽑다.e: Covers pulling out teeth or weeds and picking people, like drawing a name from a hat.
뽑다.t: Pronounced [뽑따] — the ㄷ after ㅂ becomes tense.

당연하다.x: You studied hard, so of course you passed.
당연하다.e: Literally 'properly so': just as it should be.
당연하다.t: 당연하죠! is a friendly 'Of course!'; the adverb is 당연히.

적절하다.ex: 상황에 적절한 말을 하는 것이 중요해요.
적절하다.x: It's important to say what fits the situation.
적절하다.t: 적절하다 means exactly appropriate; 적당하다 leans toward 'moderate, about right'.

창조.ex: 이 영화는 새로운 문화 창조에 큰 역할을 했어요.
창조.x: This movie played a big role in creating a new culture.

일반적.ex: 일반적으로 한국 사람들은 저녁을 일곱 시쯤 먹어요.
일반적.x: Generally, Koreans eat dinner around seven o'clock.
일반적.e: Literally 'of one kind' — what applies to everyone.
일반적.t: 일반적으로 'generally' is a handy sentence opener in TOPIK writing.

납부하다.ex: 이번 달 말까지 전기 요금을 납부해야 합니다.
납부하다.x: You must pay the electricity bill by the end of this month.
납부하다.e: Literally 'pay in and hand over' to an authority.
납부하다.t: 납부하다 is formal, used on bills and notices; in conversation people just say 내다.

용서.ex: 진심으로 사과하면 용서를 받을 수 있을 거예요.
용서.x: If you sincerely apologize, you'll probably be forgiven.
용서.t: 용서를 빌다 = to beg for forgiveness; 용서해 주세요 = Please forgive me.

홍대.m: Hongdae (Seoul area known for indie music and busking)
홍대.x: I hung out with my friends in Hongdae on Friday night.
홍대.e: Short for 홍익대학교 (Hongik University): 홍익 'broadly benefit (people)' + 대(학교) 'university'.
홍대.t: Means both the university and the lively area around it, full of clubs, cafés and buskers; the main stop is 홍대입구역.

연말정산.x: I got a little tax back through the year-end settlement.
연말정산.e: Literally 'year-end exact settling' — Korea's annual tax refund process for employees.
연말정산.t: Every January, Korean workers submit receipts at work — like a simplified tax return.

성차별.ex: 회사에서 성차별을 겪으면 신고할 수 있어요.
성차별.x: If you experience gender discrimination at work, you can report it.

학벌.m: academic pedigree (prestige of one's school); academic elitism
학벌.ex: 한국 사회에서는 아직도 학벌을 중요하게 여겨요.
학벌.x: Korean society still places a lot of weight on which school you went to.
학벌.t: 학력 is how far you studied; 학벌 is how prestigious your school was.

학회.ex: 다음 달에 일본에서 열리는 학회에 참석해요.
학회.x: Next month I'm attending a conference in Japan.

손해 배상.ex: 피해자는 회사를 상대로 손해 배상을 청구했습니다.
손해 배상.x: The victim filed a claim for damages against the company.
손해 배상.t: Collocation: 손해 배상을 청구하다 = to claim damages.

겁나다.m: to be scared, to be frightened
겁나다.ex: 혼자 밤길을 걷는 게 좀 겁나요.
겁나다.x: I'm a little scared to walk alone at night.
겁나다.e: 겁 'fear' + 나다 'to arise' — fear comes up in you.
겁나다.t: Pronounced [검나다] — nasalization. In casual speech 겁나 also means 'super': 겁나 맛있어.

당혹스럽다.x: I was suddenly asked a hard question, so I felt flustered.

지혜롭다.x: A wise person stays calm even when angry.

감염병.ex: 손을 자주 씻으면 감염병을 예방할 수 있어요.
감염병.x: Washing your hands often can prevent infectious diseases.
감염병.e: 감염 = infection (literally 'catching a stain') plus -병 = disease.
감염병.t: 감염병 is now the official term; older texts use 전염병 (contagious disease).

정체되다.m: to be stagnant, to stall; to be congested (traffic)
정체되다.ex: 출근 시간이라 도로가 많이 정체되어 있어요.
정체되다.x: It's rush hour, so the roads are heavily congested.
정체되다.t: Homonym warning: 정체 (正體) means true identity, as in 정체를 밝히다.

방관하다.m: to stand by and watch, to look on without acting
방관하다.ex: 어려운 이웃을 보고도 방관해서는 안 돼요.
방관하다.x: We shouldn't just stand by when we see neighbors in trouble.

붕괴되다.m: to collapse, to crumble, to break down
붕괴되다.x: The bridge collapsed in the earthquake, cutting off the village.

업신여기다.m: to look down on, to despise, to treat with contempt
업신여기다.ex: 가난하다고 사람을 업신여기는 것은 옳지 않아요.
업신여기다.x: It's wrong to look down on people because they're poor.
업신여기다.e: Ends in 여기다 'to regard' — regarding someone as worthless.
업신여기다.t: Pronounced [업씬녀기다] — an extra ㄴ sound is added before 여.

방대하다.m: vast, massive, extensive (in scope or volume)
방대하다.ex: 이 도서관은 방대한 자료를 가지고 있어요.
방대하다.x: This library has a vast collection of materials.
방대하다.e: Both syllables mean 'big' — literally 'huge and big'.
방대하다.t: Used for quantity or scope: 방대한 양, 방대한 자료, 방대한 규모.

명맥을 잇다.forms: 명맥을 이어요 · 명맥을 이었어요 · 명맥을 이어 가다 (ㅅ irregular)
명맥을 잇다.m: to keep (a tradition) alive; to carry on a dwindling line
명맥을 잇다.ex: 몇몇 장인들이 전통 공예의 명맥을 잇고 있습니다.
명맥을 잇다.x: A few master artisans are keeping the traditional craft alive.
명맥을 잇다.e: Literally 'to continue the life pulse' of something nearly gone.

평민.ex: 옛날에는 평민이 양반이 되기가 매우 어려웠어요.
평민.x: In the past, it was very hard for a commoner to become an aristocrat.

긍지.m: pride, dignity (in one's role or group)
긍지.ex: 그는 소방관이라는 직업에 큰 긍지를 가지고 있어요.
긍지.x: He takes great pride in his job as a firefighter.

수요곡선.ex: 가격이 오르면 수요곡선을 따라 수요량이 줄어듭니다.
수요곡선.x: When the price rises, the quantity demanded falls along the demand curve.

국정운영.ex: 대통령은 국정운영에 대한 국민의 신뢰를 회복해야 합니다.
국정운영.x: The president must restore public trust in how the country is run.

정책결정.ex: 정책결정 과정에 시민의 의견이 반영되어야 해요.
정책결정.x: Citizens' opinions should be reflected in the policy-making process.

인도적 지원.forms: 인도적 지원을 하다 · 인도적 지원이 필요하다
인도적 지원.ex: 정부는 지진 피해 국가에 인도적 지원을 보내기로 했습니다.
인도적 지원.x: The government decided to send humanitarian aid to the earthquake-hit country.
인도적 지원.e: Literally 'aid in the way of humanity'.
인도적 지원.t: Don't confuse 인도 'humanity' with the homonyms 인도 'India' and 인도 'sidewalk'.

안빈낙도.m: contentment in poverty, finding joy in the right way despite being poor
안빈낙도.x: The poet sang of a life content in poverty.
안빈낙도.e: Literally 'at ease in poverty, enjoying the Way'.
안빈낙도.t: Pronounced [안빈낙또]; a common theme in classical Korean poetry (시조, 가사).

대사증후군.x: Belly fat is a warning sign of metabolic syndrome.
대사증후군.e: Literally 'a group of metabolic symptoms and signs'.

가시광선.ex: 사람의 눈은 가시광선만 볼 수 있습니다.
가시광선.x: The human eye can see only visible light.
가시광선.e: Literally 'light rays that can be seen'.

조선업.ex: 한국의 조선업은 세계적인 경쟁력을 가지고 있습니다.
조선업.x: Korea's shipbuilding industry is globally competitive.
조선업.e: Literally 'ship-building business'; -업 = industry, business: 조선업, 제조업.
조선업.t: Not related to the Joseon dynasty (朝鮮) — same sound, different hanja.

의인법.x: 'The wind whispers to the leaves' is a sentence using personification.
의인법.e: Literally 'imitate-person method' — treating things as if they were human.
의인법.t: Pronounced [의인뻡] — 법 is tensed in these device names.

행위예술.ex: 그 작가는 거리에서 행위예술 공연을 펼쳤어요.
행위예술.x: The artist staged a performance art piece on the street.
행위예술.e: Literally 'act art' — the artist's actions are the artwork.

임시정부.m: provisional government (esp. the one in Shanghai, 1919)
임시정부.x: The Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea was founded in Shanghai in 1919.
임시정부.e: Literally 'government for the time at hand'.

극구.ex: 그는 상을 받는 것을 극구 사양했어요.
극구.x: He firmly declined to accept the award.
극구.e: Literally 'with all one's mouth': using every word to insist.

확증편향.ex: 사람들은 확증편향 때문에 믿고 싶은 정보만 찾습니다.
확증편향.x: Because of confirmation bias, people look only for information they want to believe.

새활용.x: I upcycled old jeans into a bag.
새활용.e: Native 새 'new' + 활용 'use'; the recommended Korean replacement for 업사이클링.
새활용.t: Pronounced [새화룡]: the ㄹ links into the next syllable.

창달하다.m: to promote, to foster, to develop freely (culture, speech)
창달하다.ex: 정부는 민족 문화를 창달하기 위해 노력해야 합니다.
창달하다.x: The government must work to foster the nation's culture.
창달하다.e: Literally 'flourish and reach far' — letting culture grow freely.

형해화.m: hollowing out, becoming an empty shell (of a system or law)
형해화.ex: 감시 기능이 없으면 그 제도는 형해화될 수 있어요.
형해화.x: Without oversight, that system could become an empty shell.
형해화.e: Literally 'turning into a skeleton': the form remains but the substance is gone.

구매력.x: When prices rise, consumers' purchasing power falls.
구매력.t: -력 means 'power, ability' and is very productive: 경쟁력, 생산력.
